system.name: IKS (Intelligent Knowledge Store)
system.one_liner: a type-2 CXL scale-out near-memory accelerator that speeds up exact nearest-neighbor search for retrieval-augmented generation

components.name: CB 0
components.role: first of 512 memory-mapped Context Buffers used to communicate offload context and doorbells

components.name: CB 511
components.role: last of the 512 memory-mapped Context Buffers

components.name: IKS (CXL) Memory
components.role: IKS internal DRAM, scratchpad spaces, and configuration registers mapped into host address space

components.role: regular host DRAM/CXL memory storing the actual documents

components.name: CPU
components.role: runs the vector database application and issues iks_search(query) offloads

components.name: GPU

components.name: IKS

components.role: Near-Memory Accelerator implementing an LPDDR5X memory controller and accelerator logic, one per LPDDR5X package

components.name: LPDDR5X Package

components.name: Processing Engine 0

components.name: Processing Engine 63
components.role: the last of 64 per-NMA processing engines

components.name: Query Scratchpad
components.role: stores the query vector for a processing engine

components.name: Dot-Product Unit
components.role: computes similarity scores between the query and embedding vectors read from DRAM

components.name: MAC 0
components.role: first of 68 MAC units performing multiply-accumulate operations in the Dot-Product Unit

components.name: MAC 67
components.role: last of 68 MAC units in the Dot-Product Unit

components.name: Top-K Unit
components.role: maintains an ordered list of the top-K similarity scores

components.name: Output Scratchpad
components.role: stores the processing engine's final top-K results, mapped to host memory

components.name: Memory Controllers
components.role: interface between the 8x LPDDR5X channels and the processing engines

components.name: Control Unit
components.role: generates memory accesses, controls data movement, and activates processing engines

components.name: PCIe Controller
components.role: handles the x2 PCIe uplinks from the NMA to the CXL controller

components.name: MAC Unit 0
components.role: detailed MAC unit computing one dimension's product-accumulate for the dot product

components.name: MAC Unit 67
components.role: last of 68 detailed MAC units in the Dot-Product Unit

components.name: Shift and Compare Unit
components.role: inserts an incoming similarity score into the ordered score list if it beats the current worst score

components.name: Ordered Score List
components.role: maintains the sorted top-K scores for a processing engine

coherent notification and top-K results via CXL.cache

content.key_idea: IKS is a scale-out near-memory CXL accelerator where each of several Near-Memory Accelerators drives its own LPDDR5X package with 64 parallel processing engines, each running a dot-product and top-K pipeline over locally stored embeddings, all exposed to the host through memory-mapped context buffers and CXL.cache coherence.
content.reading_order: Top to bottom through four zoom levels: (a) the host address-space mapping of context buffers and IKS memory, (b) system integration of CPU/GPU/IKS via CXL, (c) one NMA's internal array of processing engines, and (d) the Dot-Product and Top-K unit internals.

evidence: Figure 5 provides an overview of the Intelligent Knowledge Store (IKS) architecture.
IKS incorporates a scale-out near-memory processing architecture with low-profile accelerators positioned near the memory controllers
each NMA implements 64 processing engines to accommodate similarity score calculations for up to 64 query vectors

summary: This four-panel figure documents the Intelligent Knowledge Store (IKS), a CXL type-2 near-memory accelerator for exact nearest-neighbor search in RAG pipelines, at progressively finer granularity. Panel (a) shows IKS's internal DRAM, scratchpads, and 512 memory-mapped Context Buffers (64 per NMA) mapped alongside Host Memory in the shared host address space. Panel (b) shows system integration: a CPU (running the vector database and issuing iks_search offloads) and a GPU (running the LLM) both reach IKS's embedding-holding memory over CXL.mem/cache, through a CXL controller connected via PCIe to multiple Near-Memory Accelerators (NMAs), each driving its own LPDDR5X package over 8 channels. Panel (c) zooms into one NMA, showing 64 parallel Processing Engines (each with a Query Scratchpad, Dot-Product Unit, Top-K Unit, and Output Scratchpad) fed by Memory Controllers and coordinated by a Control Unit, with an explicit legend distinguishing control and data signal arrows. Panel (d) details the Dot-Product Unit's 68 MAC units and the Top-K Unit's Shift-and-Compare logic maintaining an Ordered Score List. The figure is drawn in a mostly grayscale, dense block-diagram style typical of hardware architecture papers.
summary_zh: 该图分四层展示 IKS 近内存 CXL 加速器架构：(a) 主机地址空间中的上下文缓冲区与 IKS 内存映射；(b) CPU/GPU 通过 CXL 与多个近内存加速器（NMA）及其 LPDDR5X 封装的系统集成；(c) 单个 NMA 内 64 个处理引擎的内部结构；(d) 点积单元与 Top-K 单元的电路细节。
notes: Figure 5 is a composite of four sub-panels (a-d); this record covers all of them together as one figure entry, following the caption's own grouping.
